items.information:
BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin'
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dfb7c40e4726a4e50ed5a25058aa0a73ec95b070/wcc-banner.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3BaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8d2ce427e5b4eee60c1f5d187a10c67246d67089/timebase.png)
- This competition will be using the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase**! We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a newer, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors!
- *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
- This competition is sponsored by **TheCubicle**! Check out the "Sponsor" tab for more information.

A warm welcome to the fourth competition in the spring season of Uppsalaligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). 

More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

items.name: German Open 2024
items.information:
In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2024 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun!

Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2024 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2024
items.information:
**Deutsch**

Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur zweiten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, tolle Preise, Verpflegung, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. 

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

We warmly invite you to the second competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you in large numbers. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, great prices, food, a motivated organization team and much more.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

items.information:
This competition takes place on a **Tuesday Evening** and will only feature 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3x3 Blindfolded. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
